reviews.text: Good vets prices not to bad

As soon as I walked in, I was impressed the place is spotless and clean. No smells of any kind.

The receptionist was friendly helpful and organised

Susan, the Vet was extremely helpful and gave my Dog a thorough examination

They have tea and coffee facilities if you have to wait sometime.
Staff are always helpful and friendly. Our dog loves coming to visit.
Amazing staff. Very friendly, very good with animals. What more could you want.

These vets came out to visit us out of hours even though we were not registered to see our very sick goat. Very nice people and from that visit we have moved all our animals to this practice. Highly recommended
